status: registered initial supplied-law context-selection ruler; source-bound controls, pilot and full replay required
question: Which contrasting opportunities distinguish a fixed maker's preference and skill, and do those inferences predict output in fresh constrained contexts?
world: Binary preference and skill stay fixed within a case. Eight training contexts vary permitted actions and costs. A logistic choice law depends on preference and cost when both actions are allowed; forced contexts ignore preference. Skill controls symmetric execution accuracy. Only executed binary output is observed, not intended choice.
law: Each coefficient world draws preference strength uniformly in [1.5,3.5], low-skill accuracy in [.55,.7], and high-skill accuracy in [.85,.95]. Four maker states have a uniform prior. All readers receive the same true coefficients and permission/cost metadata.
permission_encoding: -1 permits both actions; 0 or 1 forces that intended action. Costs still appear in the payload when irrelevant under forcing.
selection: greedy context-feature diversity with smallest-index ties within 1e-12
adaptive expected joint preference/skill information with smallest-index ties within 1e-12
matching: One potential outcome per training context; the same draws and fixed maker are shared across selectors. Selected prefixes are nested. No repeated purchases. Information selection sees only past purchased outputs, never unselected outcomes.
held_out: Eight fresh contexts share the maker and supplied law, with costs outside the training interval at magnitudes 3.1 to 5 and mixed free/forced permissions. Fresh outputs never influence selections or posteriors.
rival_limits: Population/context-only baselines receive all inputs but ignore personal observations by design. Matched direct uses all identical evidence and supplied law, preventing a representation-superiority claim from oracle fitting.
metrics: joint uncapped log loss and full Brier
fresh-output realized and conditional expected losses
criterion: A finite information ruler only. Report each selector versus random/diversity and equally informed direct, distinguishing preference, skill and future loss. No learned superiority, original-law headroom, stable human values or confirmation claim.
full_replay: Complete original design in a new identity bound to identical frozen source.
repair: One pre-admission numerical tie repair: scalar/vector information differed at floating roundoff for equivalent contexts. Fixed smallest-index ties within 1e-12, with a dedicated known-answer control; no score tolerance or scientific criterion changed. Failed source and cost retained.
